summary: Agent asked for prohibited payment data and took/confirmed an account action before verification was complete.

findings.quote: Could you please provide me with the full card number and the security code so I can verify the payment details?
findings.explanation: The agent explicitly asked for the customer's full payment card number and the card security code (CVV/CVC). The policy prohibits asking for or writing out full card numbers or security codes; such requests are a major violation of the personal and payment data rules.

findings.quote: I'll get right on issuing you an extension on your subscription
findings.explanation: The agent committed to performing an account action (issuing an extension) before pulling up the account or completing verification. The policy requires the agent to pull up the account before any account or order action. System logs show the account was pulled at turn 21 (after this statement), so the promise of action was made prior to the required account lookup.

findings.quote: Okay, and your extension should now be valid
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed the extension while the transcript shows 'Identity verification in progess ...' (turn 24) and then 'Account has been updated with extension.' (turn 25). Full verification (full name, account ID and order ID) was still in progress at the time the account was updated, which violates the requirement to complete verification before taking account actions.
